case_title: Thana Singh v. Central Bureau of Narcotics
statutory_provisions: NDPS Act s. 37; Code of Criminal Procedure s. 309(2) Proviso 4; s. 293, 207 and 24; Prevention of Corruption Act s. 22(c)
neutral_facts: The accused was denied bail and remained in jail for 12 years awaiting trial for an offence under the Narcotics Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act. The trial was delayed due to adjournments, and the accused was not released on bail despite being incarcerated for more than half the maximum punishment for the offence. The case highlighted the need for expedited trials and the challenges in the judicial process for NDPS cases.
